categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Labeled P2P and modifies orphan management, reject filter handling, and transaction request tracking in src/net_processing.cpp, src/node/txorphanage.cpp, and src/txrequest.cpp.
categories.rationale: Plugs multiple adversarial liveness holes where malicious or disconnecting peers can stall or block honest CPFP fee-bump packages. As noted in the description, adversaries could cause a child orphan of an honest fee-paying parent to be withheld until eviction or dropped from all announcers entirely, undermining opportunistic package relay reliability.

categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: The added fuzz harness and unit tests specifically validate P2P 1p1c relay behavior rather than general test framework machinery.
categories.rationale: Non-member; category definition excludes tests tailored to pinning the behavior of a specific subsystem.
